t: The STIHL FSA 30 is a lightweight cordless grass trimmer designed for efficient garden maintenance, ideal for precisely trimming lawn edges and clearing vegetation around trees, under shrubs, or along garden walls and stairs. Its brushless motor delivers reliable performance, while the adjustable shaft length from 116-134 cm and a multi-angle loop handle ensure comfortable operation for various tasks. The PolyCut 3-2 mowing head features tool-free replacement blade storage, enhancing productivity. Powered by the 10.8V AS System battery, it offers up to 19 minutes of run time, making it a versatile tool for professional landscapers and dedicated gardeners.
b: 2 Year Manufacturer’s Warranty Domestic Use (Proof of purchase required, T&Cs apply)
